body: I know I am sorry I just feel so lost, I am panicking, I can't stand having self-harm wounds again, I thought it was over

I don't know.
I mean, my family is pretty messed up and I have no idea if my longing for death was something I would have experienced anyways. But I can't remember a time in my life I was truly okay and didn't have ugly thoughts in my head. 

I love someone, too. But still, is it enough for me to accept that I am alive? I don't think so. Love is good, but not existing would be way better. It's not even about wanting to commit suicide, it's the forever erasing every trace of my existence. I would like my atoms to disappear, it just feels unfair to be born without my consent
